Salt and vinegar pork crackling.d: Pork belly roasted slow, then blasted in a fierce oven until the skin puffs and shatters. Cut bite-size, with pickled onions and hot mustard.
Salt and vinegar pork crackling.note: From the hot table, per half pound.

Chinatown dumplings.d: Crisp on the bottom, steamed on top. Soy, black vinegar and fresh ginger to dip.

Chopped cheese.d: Ground beef and onions worked fine on the griddle, melted American folded through, then lettuce, tomato and mayo on a toasted roll.
Chopped cheese.note: Today's special. Free delivery within 16 blocks.

Eddie's birthday cake.d: Two rich cocoa layers, filled and frosted with dark buttercream.
Eddie's birthday cake.note: Whole cakes, 24 hours notice. Candles free.

Bodega iced coffee with condensed milk.d: Brewed strong, poured over ice and a thick sweet spoonful from the can, stirred creamy. Pinch of cinnamon.
Bodega iced coffee with condensed milk.note: Fax by 7:30 for the 8 A.M. run.
